count_finding.cause: A STATE signal against an EVENT-shaped scheduler. The sign of a 10-bar return is defined on nearly every bar, so the flags form 1 / 1 / 3 contiguous runs; skill_test.simulate_schedule takes AT MOST ONE entry per contiguous run, on its first bar (slice 17 — the rule that makes the rotation null valid). The thesis is NOT rare: there are 441 / 209 / 201 sign flips in the three corpora, so a scheduler that broke runs at direction changes would produce a several-hundred-trade sample. That change was NOT made, because making it after seeing this count is a construction chosen to produce a sample.

control.construction: same-asset directed, whole-bar shuffle and re-base
control.why_invalid: CONSTRUCTION MISMATCH, NOT INSTRUMENT BIAS — and a DIFFERENT mismatch from slice 49's. The null PRESERVED this trigger: every surrogate reported '1 scoreable entries', not 0, so surrogates did find their own momentum setups. What collapsed them is the same scheduler interaction as the real series — one entry per contiguous run — which leaves each surrogate far below the 20-trade floor, so clause (c) failed at 100% incomplete and clauses (a) and (b) had no sample. This says nothing about the ~1.5-point cross-asset bias or the slice-46 z = +3.6 finding, both of which came from an instrument that ran.

edge.why_not_run: Two independent sufficient reasons: every symbol is below the intake's >= 50 hard gate (1 / 1 / 3), and every control is INVALID. NO M1 AND NO M2 EXIST for this family; quoting one would be fabrication, not approximation.

positive_rule: control_validated on every symbol claimed AND at least two of {BTCUSD, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT} with >= 50 scored trades AND those same symbols each at M1 >= 95 and M2 >= 95
freeze_of_this_family: NOT PERFORMED — the mission reserves it for a human decision
instrument_defect_recorded_not_repaired: simulate_schedule's one-entry-per-contiguous-run rule is correct for the EVENT signals it was designed for (slice 17) and collapses any STATE signal to one trade. Repairing it — breaking runs at direction changes, or scheduling one-position-at-a-time — would turn this 1-trade sample into a several-hundred-trade one, which is exactly why it must not be done in the slice that discovered the problem. It is a human pre-declaration, written before the run it enables, per docs/RESEARCH_HOLD.md.
standing_obstacle_added: The measurement instrument can only score EVENT-shaped signals. Any thesis expressed as a persistent STATE — a regime, a trend sign, a filter that is on for months — schedules one trade per episode under the current builder, regardless of how often the state changes. Check the flag-run structure before implementing, not after.
